{{Top|leg}}
A '''flux aperture''' was a piece of equipment used in the construction of a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. It was considered to be an easily obtainable part, along with the [[Stabilizing ring/Legends|stabilizing ring]], [[Field energizer/Legends|field energizer]] and [[Power cell/Legends|power cell]].
